entries.en: There's a job I want ya to handle.
entries.uk: Є робота, яку я хочу[n]тобі доручити.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: I'm free tonight,[n]so stop by the shop.

entries.speaker: Iwai

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: OK. I'll be waiting.

entries.speaker: Morgana
